$comment: Which Codex Dream Skin themes become skins here, and the rights each one ships under. npm run import:dream -- --upstream <checkout> regenerates every skin listed; a theme is added by adding an entry, never by writing a skin by hand. Only art the upstream licenses for redistribution is listed; what is left out, and why, is under excluded.
copyright: Copyright (c) 2026 Codex Dream Skin Studio contributors
disclaimer: Codex Dream Skin is an unofficial customization project, not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by OpenAI. Neither these skins nor their names imply any OpenAI or Codex affiliation.

themes.summary: Gothic Void Crusade：烛金与深红的哥特大教堂浮于虚空，为专注而设的庄严地平线（Codex Dream Skin 主题移植）。

artwork.grant: Created and contributed by its author for inclusion in the MIT-licensed Codex Dream Skin project; upstream ships it as the redistributable default artwork of its public installers (upstream macos/NOTICE.md, section Gothic Void Crusade).

themes.summary: Dream Skin 红白：玫瑰红光穹与白色未来城的抽象晨景，红白配色（Codex Dream Skin 默认主题移植）。

artwork.grant: Original abstract art with no characters, generated for the Codex Dream Skin repository and covered by its MIT licence (upstream macos/NOTICE.md, section Demo artwork; macos/references/asset-provenance.md records it as generated with gpt-image-2 for that project, under an earlier file hash).

excluded.why: A real person's likeness. Upstream macos/NOTICE.md excludes these files from the MIT licence and says redistribution needs an independent rights review. npm run dream -- <theme dir or zip> can still turn such a theme into a local skin for your own use; it is never written under skins/.

excluded.theme: docs/images/* (DeepSeek-鲸鱼娘, haizeiwang, jinx-codex, 悟空, gallery/skin-*, banners, screenshots)
excluded.why: README and promotional images of franchise characters or of the app itself, not theme packs. Upstream's NOTICE grants no rights to character likenesses or franchise art.

Not part of the upstream repository. The ones whose declared licence allows redistribution are indexed, metadata only, in sources/dreamskin-community.json and converted on demand by npm run dream -- --all or -- <ver_id>; their pictures are never committed.
